verdict.line: You fall behind if you trade autos into an open Riposte or eat a double Lunge before level 6, but you win the lane if you poke exclusively with Cleaver and scale into Warmog's/Titanic Hydra.

brief.thesis: Fiora's whole kit is a melee dash-and-parry package that punishes you for walking into auto-attack range, while Infected Cleaver is a 975-range, %max-health throw that is not a basic attack and so cannot be caught by Riposte. The lane is a fight over that range gap: the 48.3% win rate over 178 games shows Fiora currently wins it more often because her dash resets and kill-refreshed Burst of Speed let her force the engage before you stack enough health to make Adrenaline Rush and Cleaver actually hurt.

theirWindow.when: Q, W, E all off cooldown
theirWindow.what: With Lunge, Riposte, and Burst of Speed all up she can double-dash in, bait a parry, and chain attack speed into a kill attempt — hold your ground, don't auto, and be ready to burn Sadism (R) to run rather than stand and trade.

yourWindow.when: after she burns both Lunge dashes
yourWindow.what: Lunge can be cast a second time for free within a couple seconds, but once both charges and her Riposte parry are spent she has no insurance left — step in with Q and autos freely until her Q cooldown (16s at rank 1, down to 8s at rank 5) comes back.

powerCurve.note: Blade Waltz adds a burst kill-threat
Titanic Hydra scaling outlasts her damage

start.why: The regen and damage reduction on hit (49.7% WR, 69.6% pick) blunt both her auto-attack poke and the Duelist passive stacking off those same autos.

boots.why: Her kill pressure is entirely basic-attack and Lunge-strike based (51.5% pick), so flat physical damage reduction does more for you than movement speed in the early trades.

core.why: Raw HP makes Adrenaline Rush's per-second regen and Infected Cleaver's max-health scaling both hit harder (73.3% WR path).
Stacks even more max health on top of Warmog's, directly inflating Cleaver damage and your effective HP in extended fights.
Current-health nuke on hit gives you real damage output once your HP pool is big, closing the gap with her Duelist sustain.

situational.when: she's stacking Duelist healing fast and winning early skirmishes on sustain alone
her on-hit healing is keeping her alive through full trades late game
you need more raw regen to out-sustain repeated poke before her all-in windows
her Burst of Speed stacking move speed is letting her stick to you and dictate every chase

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on an auto every few seconds, permanently grows your max health, and heals you — exactly the kind of low-intensity, HP-scaling sustain that lets you out-regen her poke instead of needing to win trades outright.

summoners.why: Ghost's measured 56.2% win rate (45.3% pick) is the highest of the three combos — the flat move speed directly counters her Burst of Speed chase stacking, while Teleport lets you reset at base and come back with your sustain items online.

playing.title: Poke, don't melee trade
playing.detail: Spam Q (Infected Cleaver, 4s cooldown, 975 range) from max range — it is a projectile, not a basic attack, so it walks straight through her Riposte (W) parry.

playing.title: Track her W parry window
playing.detail: Riposte's cooldown runs 10s down to 6s by rank 5; if it's up, don't walk into auto-attack range and let her bait you into the reflect.

playing.title: Respect the double Lunge
playing.detail: Q (Lunge) can be cast a second time within a couple seconds for free — assume she has two dashes loaded, not one, before you commit to a trade.

playing.title: Bank R for chase, not combat
playing.detail: Sadism (R, 75s cooldown) trades health for heavy move speed and regen — save it to break off from her E-fueled chase speed rather than to force an all-in.

playing.title: Watch her ult timer after 6
playing.detail: Blade Waltz (R, 130s cooldown at rank 1) is a multi-hit finisher with diminishing damage on repeat strikes to the same target — track roughly when she last could have used it before you extend a trade.

playing.title: Hold E for when you're already low
playing.detail: Masochism (E, 7s cooldown) scales your AD with missing health, so it's strongest in the second half of a fight, not the opener.

playing.title: Scale through items, not skirmishes
playing.detail: Warmog's into Heartsteel into Titanic Hydra (73.3% WR sample) turns your %max-health Cleaver into real damage and gives Adrenaline Rush enough HP to out-race her Duelist sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade logic and timing reads are my own analysis of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of having (P) exposed! Retreat out of Fiora’s sight to change the location of your Vitals. Stick by a wall when she uses (R) while fighting her.
